name: Celestial Body
body:
School abjuration (good); Level cleric 3, inquisitor 3, paladin 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, DF

EFFECT

Range touch
Target one good creature
Duration 1 round/level (D)
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

The body of the touched creature is infused with divine protection. The creature touched gains damage reduction 5/evil.
